query: SELECT name, LEFT(therapeuticProperties, 80) as properties FROM molecules WHERE (name LIKE '%Pinène%' OR name LIKE '%Linalool%' OR name LIKE '%Humulène%' OR name LIKE '%Myrcène%' OR name LIKE '%Limonène%' OR name LIKE '%Caryophyllène%') AND therapeuticProperties IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name;
